Suggestions for gate calls for guests
What you should know comes first

Topic: Gate calls and pet travel readiness

This help-center article is meant to support safe and calm travel with companion animals through Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk asks guests to follow gate calls promptly, keep carriers secure, and stay attentive to staff directions. A safety reviewer looks first for clear movement, quiet handling, and conditions that reduce stress for animals and nearby travelers.

Before boarding, please keep your animal settled in an approved carrier or on a lead when staff permit it. Bring only the items needed for comfort and cleanliness, and make sure food, water, and absorbent materials are arranged so they do not spill during movement. If your pet shows signs of distress, tell a staff member at once so a trained team member can assist.

Thornwick travelers should use the pet relief area only as directed by airport staff, and they should follow posted guidance carefully. <<FACT F016>> Keep your route calm and direct, and return to the gate without delay after the relief stop. If you are uncertain about where to go, ask the nearest coordinator rather than making an unsupervised choice.

Vellmar guests should also review their travel arrangements with care before reaching the gate. <<FACT F008>> This helps the team maintain a safe flow at the checkpoint and reduces avoidable delays for companion animals and their handlers. Follow all carrier checks and boarding instructions, since orderly movement protects both welfare and security.

Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and travelers are expected to cooperate with calm, respectful conduct. If you need further help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for the latest guidance.
